'''Sinjan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
The planet was the site of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Sinjan Outpost|base]] compromised by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[espionage droid]].<ref name="SA" />
